source.check: names and divisions read on the OCR of the Derry Journal's nomination list of 16 April 1924

note: Nomination-day report for the thirty-nine electoral divisions of Omagh rural district, one member each. Twenty-three Unionist candidates were nominated and returned unopposed; no nominations were received in the remaining sixteen divisions, whose seats were filled by co-option. There was no contest and no poll. Sole nomination; returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
